boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named USF campus study environments, including officially identified quiet places and Gleeson Library study zones.

cards.entity_name: Cozy Nook outside the CASA Office
cards.title: CASA’s UC 3 Cozy Nook
cards.subtitle: University Center, third floor
cards.notes: Bring independent work to the nook outside the Center for Academic and Student Achievement office, identified by USF as a quiet place on campus.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet nook on University Center’s third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: USF’s Quiet Places on Campus page identifies a “Cozy nook outside the CASA Office on UC 3.”
cards.source_title: Quiet Places on Campus | University of San Francisco
cards.access_notes: Located in the University Center; follow current campus building-access rules.

cards.title: University Center 5 Lounge
cards.subtitle: University Center, fifth floor
cards.notes: Set up in the fifth-floor lounge when a designated quiet campus location suits your reading, drafting, or laptop work.
cards.short_summary: A quiet lounge area on UC 5.
cards.evidence_claim: USF’s Quiet Places on Campus page identifies a “Lounge area on UC 5.”
cards.source_title: Quiet Places on Campus | University of San Francisco
cards.access_notes: Located in the University Center; follow current campus building-access rules.

cards.title: Lo Schiavo Basement Lounge
cards.subtitle: John Lo Schiavo Center for Science and Innovation
cards.notes: Use this named basement lounge for a change of setting between classes; USF includes it in its campus quiet-places guide.
cards.short_summary: A listed quiet lounge in Lo Schiavo’s basement.
cards.evidence_claim: USF’s Quiet Places on Campus page identifies the “Lo Schiavo Basement Lounge.”
cards.source_title: Quiet Places on Campus | University of San Francisco
cards.access_notes: Located in the Lo Schiavo Center for Science and Innovation; follow current building-access rules.

cards.title: Kalmanovitz Atrium
cards.subtitle: Kalmanovitz Hall
cards.notes: Choose the atrium for independent work in a named quiet-place location, and keep the setting usable for others sharing the space.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet-study setting in Kalmanovitz Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: USF’s Quiet Places on Campus page identifies the “Kalmanovitz Atrium.”
cards.source_title: Quiet Places on Campus | University of San Francisco
cards.access_notes: Located in Kalmanovitz Hall; follow current building-access rules.

cards.title: Kalmanovitz Annex
cards.subtitle: Kalmanovitz Hall
cards.notes: Head to the Kalmanovitz Annex for a quiet-place option distinct from the building’s atrium when you need to focus on coursework.
cards.short_summary: A second named quiet-study setting in Kalmanovitz Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: USF’s Quiet Places on Campus page identifies the “Kalmanovitz Annex.”
cards.source_title: Quiet Places on Campus | University of San Francisco
cards.access_notes: Located in Kalmanovitz Hall; follow current building-access rules.

cards.title: Malloy Hall Entrance Lounge
cards.subtitle: Malloy Hall
cards.notes: Use the entrance lounge as a named quiet-place option for a reading session or focused laptop task inside Malloy Hall.
cards.short_summary: A quiet lounge at the Malloy Hall entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: USF’s Quiet Places on Campus page identifies the “Malloy Hall Entrance Lounge.”
cards.source_title: Quiet Places on Campus | University of San Francisco
cards.access_notes: Located in Malloy Hall; follow current building-access rules.

cards.title: Malloy Hall Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Malloy Hall
cards.notes: Take materials to the Malloy Hall Courtyard for an outdoor quiet-place option, weather and any posted access guidance permitting.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor quiet-study option at Malloy Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: USF’s Quiet Places on Campus page identifies the “Malloy Hall Courtyard.”
cards.source_title: Quiet Places on Campus | University of San Francisco
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus location; follow current building and courtyard access guidance.

cards.title: Gleeson Library Atrium
cards.subtitle: Gleeson Library | Geschke Center, first floor
cards.notes: Use the Atrium for quiet solo work; USF’s library study-zone guidance specifically classifies the first-floor Atrium as quiet study.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor quiet-study zone in Gleeson Library.
cards.evidence_claim: USF identifies the Gleeson Library Atrium as a quiet place, and library guidance classifies the first-floor Atrium as a quiet study zone.
cards.access_notes: USF states that students need a valid USF ID to access the library building.

cards.title: Gleeson Library Fourth Floor
cards.subtitle: Gleeson Library | Geschke Center
cards.notes: Work collaboratively on the fourth floor, which USF’s study-zone guidance classifies for conversation study and its quiet-places guide photographs.
cards.short_summary: A documented conversation-study floor in Gleeson Library.
cards.evidence_claim: USF’s Quiet Places on Campus page identifies “Gleeson Library 4th Floor,” and library guidance classifies the fourth floor as a conversation study zone.
cards.source_title: Quiet Places on Campus | University of San Francisco
cards.access_notes: USF states that students need a valid USF ID to access the library building.

cards.title: Gleeson’s Silent South Floor
cards.subtitle: Gleeson Library | Geschke Center, third floor south
cards.notes: Choose the front half of Gleeson’s third-floor south area when you need a library zone explicitly designated for silent study.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent-study zone on Gleeson’s third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: USF library guidance designates the front half of Gleeson Library’s third-floor south area as a silent study zone.
cards.access_notes: USF states that students need a valid USF ID to access the library building.
